ModMetaData.name: Vanillafied Vivi
ModMetaData.author: KahirDragoon
ModMetaData.description:
Removes the visual changes made to Vivis and their race-specific apparel: Vivis become humans with the Vivi xenotype and use normal clothes and genes instead.
Content:
Race / Pawns: - Vivi pawnkinds use the Human race for full visual and mod compatibility - Removed all Vivi-specific head types and hair; Vivis use vanilla heads and hair - Apparel tags updated per pawnkind: Neolithic/Medieval for civilians, MedievalMilitary for guards, Royal/RoyalTier2 for royals (requires Royalty) - Combat power rebalanced for guard, firefighter, sniper and royal pawnkinds
Xenotype (Vivi): - Added vanilla genes: weak immunity, slow wound healing, fast runner, thin body, psychically dull, poor intellectual, heat tolerant - Added custom genes: vivi physiology, honey gatherer, vivi wings, vivi antennae, hive mind, vivi cream maker
Custom Genes: - Vivi Physiology: the core Vivi gene. Royal jelly need, becoming a royal Vivi, egg laying for royals (15-day cycle with a progress gizmo), always female, looks slightly smaller. Xenogerm side effects can make the carrier genetically unstable - Honey Gatherer: bonus stats for gathering honey and from magic plants - Vivi Wings: Vivi wings with flight animations; short flights, and always flies while drafted - Vivi Antennae: purely cosmetic - Hive Mind: no thoughts about disturbed sleep, crying babies or the death and loss of most relatives; grief for daughters and close friends is shorter - Vivi Cream Maker: unlocks the Vivicream production recipe
Apparel: - Removed all Vivi-specific apparel (garments, hats, guard uniform/helmet, winter cape, guardian coat, children's wear, crown). Can be turned off in the Vanilla Expanded Framework mod settings - Removed fake and bionic antenna/wing implants and their surgeries - Vivis wear vanilla apparel (Neolithic and Medieval tags); the faction is medieval tech so consider adding a medieval clothing mod for more variety
Architect Menu / Buildings: - Moved all Vivi buildings, furniture, floors and traps into the standard vanilla architect tabs (Production, Furniture, Misc, Security, Structure, Floors) - Removed the custom Vivi architect tab - Fortify honeycomb wall designator added to the Orders and Structure menus
Faction / Culture: - Vivi Federation patched with proper backstory filters (settler, combat, firefighter, sniper) - Vivi culture uses vanilla short/long hair instead of Vivi-exclusive styles - Race restrictions removed from Vivi backstories, royal status, weapons and consumables so they work on Human pawns; royal Vivis keep their heart attack immunity
Recipes / Research: - Vivicream production requires the vivi cream maker gene instead of the Vivi race - Vivi apparel research projects removed; if you keep the Vivi apparel, it requires Complex Clothing instead - Glider wing implant surgery available for all humans - Archite germline imprint surgery available for royal Vivis
Compatibility: - Vivi mechanics (Everflower including teleporting it, royal status, egg laying, archite germline imprint, gene inheritance across generations) work on Human pawns with the vivi physiology gene, including non-Vivis given the gene - Baby and child Vivis can sleep in an empty Vivi hatchery, just like with the Vivi race - Vivis from other factions get their random gene again, and so do starting Vivis if that option is on in the Vivi Race mod settings - Vivi weapons and combat hormone jelly can be used by any human; the learning boost from Vivi food still only lasts for Vivi children - Vivi-only behaviour from the Vivi Race mod (body type when growing up, hornet swarms, Everflower, sibling rules, extra food capacity from gene metabolism, continuous eating, no gene implanter gene and more) only applies to actual Vivis, not to every human - Race restrictions removed from the Vivi xenotype so it can be applied to Human pawns
